hooks.command: filepath=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && if [ -n "$filepath" ] && [[ "$filepath" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|jsonc)$ ]]; then npx @biomejs/biome check --write --unsafe "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; fi

filepath=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && if [[ "$filepath" =~ supabase/migrations/.*\.sql$ ]]; then echo '⚠️  Migration written. Run: npx supabase migration up && npx supabase gen types typescript --local > types/database.ts'; fi

result=$(cat) && worktree_path=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.tool_result.path // empty') && if [ -n "$worktree_path" ] && [ -d "$worktree_path" ]; then main_root=$(git -C "$worktree_path" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null | sed 's|/\.git$||') && if [ -n "$main_root" ] && [ -f "${main_root}/.env.local" ]; then cp "${main_root}/.env.local" "${worktree_path}/.env.local" && (cd "${worktree_path}" && npm install --silent) && echo "✅ Worktree ready: .env.local copied + npm install done"; fi; fi

filepath=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && if [[ "$filepath" =~ lib/crypto\.ts$ ]] || [[ "$filepath" =~ lib/supabase/admin\.ts$ ]] || [[ "$filepath" =~ lib/auth/admin\.ts$ ]]; then echo "BLOCKED: Sensitive file '$filepath' — state your reason for this change before proceeding."; exit 2; fi
